name: reason
description: Hand coding work to Reason cloud agents and follow each session to its pull request.

interface.shortDescription: Hand off code to cloud agents
interface.longDescription: Hand coding work to Reason cloud agents from chat. Describe a task, such as fixing a bug, building a feature, reviewing a pull request, making failing CI pass or answering a question about a codebase, and Reason runs it on its own cloud machine in a GitHub repository connected to your Reason workspace. Each session returns a live link, and when it changes code it opens a pull request. You can list your recent sessions and check their status, result and pull request, send a follow-up to a running session, request a pull request review and schedule recurring engineering work as a Loop. Requires a Reason account with at least one GitHub repository connected. Sign in with OAuth and choose a workspace; every action is limited to that workspace's permissions and the scopes you approve. Sessions run asynchronously, so results arrive after the session finishes.
